nodes.description: Override that performs the March 2021 spell actions: deauthorizes LERP on the Vat, raises PSM-USDC-A debt ceiling, zeroes USDC-A debt ceiling and rewrites the global Line.
Override returning false to disable the office-hours casting restriction for this spell.
Schedules the spell: checks expiration, sets eta = now + pause.delay() and calls pause.plot.
Executes the spell once: sets done = true and calls pause.exec, which re-enters the action.
Computes the earliest valid cast timestamp from eta and office-hours rules using block.timestamp.
Initializes pause, description, expiration, action, sig and the extcodehash tag for the spell.
External entrypoint guarded by the limited modifier; delegates to actions().
Modifier that enforces weekday and 14:00-21:00 UTC windows based on block.timestamp before executing.
Internal routine that onboards a collateral ilk and configures flipper, OSM, debt ceilings, fees and auction parameters.
Constructs the spell action and the DssExec base with description, expiration and action address.
Scheduled execution timestamp of the spell.
Flag marking the spell as already cast.
Immutable timestamp after which the spell can no longer be scheduled.
Immutable address of the DssSpellAction contract executed by the spell.
Immutable PauseAbstract (MCD_PAUSE) used for plot/exec of the spell.
Human-readable description of the spell for bot consumption.
Immutable extcodehash tag of the spell action, used by the pause to validate the action.
Block timestamp used for scheduling, expiration, office-hours gating and cast-time computation.
External call reading the USDC-A ilk data (line) from the Vat.
External library call that writes an ilk debt ceiling into the Vat.
External call that rewrites the global debt ceiling Line in the Vat.
External library call that denies an address (LERP) authorization on a base contract.
Unchecked arithmetic assembling the new global debt ceiling from the current Line, the 500M RAD delta and the USDC-A line.
External call to the Pause that executes the spell action and can re-enter it.
External call to the Pause that registers the spell at the computed eta.
Description string parameter of the DssExec constructor.
Expiration timestamp parameter of the DssExec constructor.
Address of the spell action parameter of the DssExec constructor.
CollateralOpts struct parameter supplying all ilk configuration values to addNewCollateral.
Local variable holding the USDC-A line read from vat.ilks.
Local variable holding the VatAbstract instance cast from DssExecLib.vat().
Local variable in nextCastTime holding the computed earliest valid cast time.
Assembly local variable in the DssExec constructor receiving extcodehash.
Assembly local variable in the DssExec constructor holding the spell action address.

edges.reason: block.timestamp drives the weekday/hour gating in the limited modifier, making execution windows timestamp dependent.
nextCastTime derives day/hour/minute/second from block.timestamp to decide when the spell may be cast.
schedule sets eta from block.timestamp (now) plus the pause delay.
DssSpell constructor sets expiration as block.timestamp + 30 days.
schedule requires now <= expiration before scheduling the spell.
schedule requires eta == 0 to prevent double scheduling.
schedule writes the computed eta state variable.
cast passes eta to pause.exec as the execution timestamp.
cast requires !done to prevent replaying the spell.
cast marks the spell as done before executing.
cast passes the action address to pause.exec.
cast invokes exec on the pause contract.
schedule reads pause.delay() and calls pause.plot.
cast forwards the immutable tag to pause.exec for action validation.
schedule calls pause.plot with action, tag, sig and eta.
cast calls pause.exec with action, tag, sig and eta.
pause.exec calls back into DssAction.execute, so the spell action runs inside the Pause call.
execute delegates to the overridden actions() implementation.
The limited modifier wraps execute and can halt it before actions() run.
limited calls officeHours() to decide whether the casting window must be enforced.
officeHours() returning false disables the time restriction on execute for this spell.
actions deauthorizes the LERP contract from the Vat, an access-control sensitive call.
actions writes the PSM-USDC-A and USDC-A debt ceilings via setIlkDebtCeiling.
actions reads the current USDC-A ilk line from the Vat.
The local vat instance is used to query ilks.
The USDC-A line returned by vat.ilks is stored in the local line variable.
line is subtracted in the unchecked Line computation.
vat.Line() is read into the unchecked global debt ceiling arithmetic.
actions computes vat.Line() + (500 * MILLION * RAD) - line without overflow/underflow protection.
The computed value is written as the new global Line via vat.file, so arithmetic errors propagate on-chain.
The local vat instance underlies the library debt ceiling updates.
The local vat instance is the target of the file(Line) call.
actions performs the vat.file(Line, ...) update.
addNewCollateral consumes all fields of the CollateralOpts parameter.
addNewCollateral sets the ilk debt ceiling through DssExecLib.setIlkDebtCeiling.
The _description parameter is stored into the description state variable.
The _expiration parameter is stored into the expiration immutable.
The _spellAction parameter is stored as action and hashed into tag.
The constructor initializes the description state variable.
The constructor initializes the expiration immutable.
The constructor initializes the action immutable.
The constructor resolves and stores the pause address from the changelog.
The assembly local _tag receives extcodehash inside the constructor.
The assembly local _action holds the spell action address inside the constructor.
The constructor writes the computed extcodehash into the tag immutable.
The DssSpell constructor invokes the DssExec base constructor with the action description, timestamp and address.
castTime is the local result computed inside nextCastTime.
nextCastTime assigns the derived cast time to the castTime local variable.

The _expiration parameter only feeds the DssExec constructor and should be folded into that function node.

The line local variable is declared and used inside actions before feeding the Line arithmetic.
The vat local variable is declared inside actions and used for the Vat reads and writes.
